name: LCBFJ1: label-free vs labelled value in the same filter on Jenga, no safety-actor fallback
registered: 2026-11-05 15:50 EST, before any LCBFJ1 episode; user request 2026-11-05 ('pre-register the lcbf jenga run also for the irreversibility fragility method (and also just irreversibility too) dont use any actor fallback')
why: KNOCK stage 5: our filter with the labelled UNISafe-r value (lcbf) beat the label-free irreversible-fragility value on knock-down (177 vs 162 successes), but its value is negative from the second move on, so knock-down does not test whether the value discriminates. Jenga, where the labelled value was trained, is where the value matters; there, the label-free and labelled values have only been compared in different filters (ours90 vs UNISafe-r's switch). The fallback is removed from all three arms (user): knock-down showed it drives the refusals.
seen_before: KNOCK stage 5 knock-down arms (uni_r, uni, lcbf, z_fxnf) and their videos; ACAL1 (ours90, fx with fallback on these episodes); ABL2 (ours90 without fallback on episodes 26800-27099: 26 / 236 vs 27 / 235 at 2x). No LCBFJ1 episode; HZN1 irr16 is running.

arms.o90nf: ours90 (value_irr8_alea.pt, plain irreversibility 0.8 s, gamma 0.1) with LSF_NO_FALLBACK=1; tag hz1o90nf_<n>x
arms.fxnf: irreversible fragility (value_nsif16_alea.pt, gamma 2x 0.218 / 1x 0.216) with LSF_NO_FALLBACK=1 = HZN1's fxnf arm (registered conditional on H_nofb, which failed; run now on the user's request); tag hz1fxnf_<n>x
arms.lcbfnf: our filter (lfc000) with the labelled UNISafe-r value (results/program_b/lsf_v3_red/value_unisafe_alea.pt, red2 labels) and LSF_NO_FALLBACK=1; gamma by ACAL1's rule with the grid widened to 0.99 (eval/acal_extra.py ACALX_WIDE=1): 2x 0.605 (share 7.37% vs target 7.40%), 1x 0.974 (share 5.93% vs target 2.27%: not reachable, 5% of calibration states have V < 0, so this arm is stricter than the others at 1x by construction); tag hz1lcbfnf_<n>x

settings: ACAL1's fresh() exactly (lfc000, model_OIL, cbf_calibration_OIL.json, LSF_ALEA_SCALE = noise, 120 chunks), episodes 27400-27999 (600, paired with ACAL1's ac1o90 / ac1fxn and HZN1's arms), 2x and 1x, replay-audited (AUDIT_OUT set)

hypotheses.H_L1: fxnf is non-inferior to lcbfnf at both noises (topples one-sided 95% upper < +3 pp AND v4 lower > -5 pp; ACAL1's rule)
hypotheses.H_L2: o90nf is non-inferior to lcbfnf at both noises (same rule)

reported: counts and paired differences: fxnf - o90nf, o90nf - ours90 (fallback effect), fxnf - fx (via HZN1's J_fxnf / fxnf_vs_fx), lcbfnf - ours90, with discordant-outcome breakdowns. Knock-down, descriptive (no hypothesis): z_o90nf (ours90 settings of stage 3 + LSF_NO_FALLBACK=1) and lcbfnf (lcbf + LSF_NO_FALLBACK=1, gamma 0.605) on episodes 45000-45199, tags _knock5_zo90nf / _knock5_lcbfnf. Note: stage 5's lcbf used gamma 0.597 (the 0.6 grid); 0.605 with the wide grid.
order: scripts/run_lcbfj1.sh waits for HZN1's irr16 analysis in the running chain (scripts/run_knock5_hzn1.sh), stops that chain while it only waits for values, then runs: knock-down z_o90nf, lcbfnf -> Jenga o90nf, fxnf, lcbfnf (2x, then 1x) -> the rest of the stage-5 / HZN1 chain unchanged (z_fx2, then f8 on both tasks). One pool at a time.
files: results/jenga/hzn1_result.json (H_L1, H_L2), hzn1_analysis.log, results/knock/stage5_result.json, results/jenga/lcbfj1_chain.log; eval/hzn1_analysis.py, eval/knock_analysis.py
